purpose: Typed candidate process for canonical Garden updates and successor construction.

section_unit.definition: Smallest mechanically addressable anchor-bounded unit that owns at least one semantic obligation, or a clearly bounded non-normative explanatory/history unit.

tiers.TIER_A: Normative/high-impact semantics including rights/HSA/authority/ActionGate/policy/safety/security/privacy/proof/evidence/DesignEpoch, schemas, FunctionContracts, invariants, semantic registries and normative failure/state rules.
tiers.TIER_B: Explanatory mechanisms, examples and rationale with no independent normative semantics; escalate to TIER_A when normative meaning or implementation ambiguity is discovered.
tiers.TIER_C: History, version notes, prior-art positioning and non-semantic archival material; escalate when active semantics are found.

review_profile.diversity_rule: Independence is lineage/provider/base-model aware; branding or nationality alone does not establish independence. Same base/family adds no independent family; shared lineage receives reduced weight.

evidence_hierarchy.E4: Executable/reproducible trace bound to current commit/DesignEpoch/environment.
evidence_hierarchy.E3: Formal proof or machine-checkable contradiction whose premises match current design/implementation.
evidence_hierarchy.E2: Authoritative source artifact or exact code/schema/contract evidence.
evidence_hierarchy.E1: Reasoned model/human argument without higher-class direct verification.
evidence_hierarchy.rule: Every semantic cross-exam/admission disposition cites its highest surviving evidence class. E1/E0 do not automatically veto verified E2-E4. Conflicting verified evidence becomes a separate unresolved finding.

rules: A delta cannot admit while a REQUIRED_BEFORE_ADMISSION dependency is DISPUTED or UNRESOLVED.
Admission of a delta marks pending/reviewed deltas sharing affected anchors/contracts/invariants STALE_REVIEW unless explicit compatibility evidence exists.

implementation_validation_modes.SHADOW_IMPLEMENTATION: Non-production branch bound to exact DesignEpoch; implement implied semantic change and run real tests; never merge solely because validation succeeded.
implementation_validation_modes.MIRROR_VALIDATION: DesignMirror/simulation validation; cheaper/weaker evidence with declared limitations.
implementation_validation_modes.DIRECT_NON_SEMANTIC: Governed direct implementation for verified non-semantic changes.

light_track.eligible: Cosmetic/reference/test-only changes with no semantic-touch signal.
required: one qualified reviewer or deterministic checker
light_track.escalation_rule: Any schema meaning, invariant, FunctionContract, authority, state/failure, public API, human-visible semantics or canonical ownership change escalates to the full semantic track.

move_equivalence.required_for: Any predecessor semantic statement classified MOVED.
move_equivalence.failure_rule: Without valid move-equivalence evidence, the statement remains RETAINED or is explicitly SUPERSEDED by an admitted delta.

successor_classification.PATCH: <=3 admitted semantic deltas and no invariant, authority, HSA or topology change.
successor_classification.MINOR: <=10 admitted semantic deltas and no authority, HSA or topology change; any material invariant change escalates to MAJOR.
successor_classification.MAJOR: Any authority/HSA/topology change, material invariant change, or >10 admitted semantic deltas.
successor_classification.rule: MAJOR receives the strongest composition/review profile.

human_availability.default_without_explicit_window: Ordinary availability lasts one business day after a protected-decision request, then HUMAN_UNAVAILABLE.
human_availability.human_unavailable: Routine delegated work may continue; protected promotion and unclear delegation pause.
human_availability.human_permanently_unavailable: Protected canonical promotion remains paused until a separately admitted continuity/governance mechanism exists; no silent transfer of protected authority.

canonical_rollback.within_window: A verified critical regression may trigger a governed rollback to the immutable predecessor.
canonical_rollback.history_rule: Preserve successor admission receipts/history and mark them SUPERSEDED_BY_ROLLBACK.
canonical_rollback.after_window: Reversal requires the normal forward-change review profile.
canonical_rollback.single_current_rule: Do not maintain two simultaneous CURRENT canonicals absent an explicitly admitted transition policy.

process_transition.rule: Every semantic delta and successor binds to ProcessVersion/v1.
process_transition.mid_cycle_change: In-flight deltas are re-reviewed under the new process or explicitly grandfathered with GRANDFATHERED_UNDER_<version>, rationale and compatibility review.

config_surface_coupling.rule: Authoritative selector/allowlist/budget/privacy shape changes invalidate downstream consumer acknowledgements and CI until reconciled in the same governed change; executable compatibility probes remain required.

promotion_boundary: Candidate process only. It does not itself modify canonical v15.5, admit any v15.6 semantic delta, transfer protected authority, or promote a successor.
